Copies one pixel from a buffer to another, or inside the same buffer. Each call has to work out where both pixels are, so for many pixels lock the buffers and use [CopyPixelFast](CopyPixelFast).

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 255, 0, 0
Rect 0, 0, 20, 20, 1
For i = 0 To 19
	CopyPixel i, i, BackBuffer(), 100 + i, 50, BackBuffer()
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```
@param src_x        Horizontal position of the pixel to copy.
@param src_y        Vertical position of the pixel to copy.
@param src_buffer   The buffer to copy from.
@param dest_x       Horizontal position to copy to.
@param dest_y       Vertical position to copy to.
@param dest_buffer  The buffer to copy to. Defaults to the current buffer.
@gap A source pixel outside of its buffer is read as 0 (black), and a destination outside its buffer is skipped.
